notes: The active spawn surface accepts task, context-forking, model and reasoning overrides but no role selector.
The installed prompt describes subagents as equal-capability contexts sharing the filesystem and tool surface.
Custom role TOML parsed without a malformed-role warning in an isolated temporary Codex home.
The built-in explorer comparator must be feature-gated because it is not exposed by the detected runtime surface.

policy.delegation: root-only; delegated agents must not delegate

evidence.locator: spawn_agent tool schema and codex debug prompt-input
supports: No role or agent_type selector is exposed.
Subagents inherit or explicitly override model and reasoning.
Subagents share the workspace and available tools.

evidence.locator: isolated CODEX_HOME app-server startup with agents/reviewer.toml
supports: The current reviewer TOML shape is accepted by the installed parser.
Reviewer model, reasoning, read-only sandbox, purpose and instructions.
Toolkit agent TOML files are linked into the Codex agent directory.
Deterministic-first routing, current skill/tool overlap and review activation policy.
code-mapper and log-analyzer were removed during routing simplification.
Their last model, sandbox and instruction contracts remain auditable.
Subagents inherit configured tools and share the environment filesystem.
Delegation is intended for independent bounded work.
The current reviewer matched generic quality on the bounded security diff.
The historical code mapper underperformed generic bounded delegation.
The broad historical log analyzer and every proposed specialist had no measured quality advantage sufficient for a persistent custom role.

builtInRoles.purpose: Own the user task, decide whether bounded delegation is justified, and synthesize subagent results.
builtInRoles.rationale: This is the required orchestration role and avoids a separate toolkit coordinator.
overlap: All candidate roles are narrower slices of root reasoning.
builtInRoles.isolationValue: None itself; it benefits when a delegated context prevents broad evidence from displacing task state.

builtInRoles.purpose: Perform an independently scoped task in a separate context with the shared filesystem and inherited capabilities.
builtInRoles.rationale: It is the only role selectable through the detected spawn surface and is the mandatory baseline for specialist evaluations.
overlap: Can perform every proposed specialist task when given a precise task message.
builtInRoles.isolationValue: High for independent evidence collection; specialization must beat this generic baseline after accounting for added routing metadata.

builtInRoles.purpose: Potential native read-only repository exploration comparator requested by the roadmap.
builtInRoles.rationale: Neither the active spawn schema nor official documentation inspected for this audit exposes a selectable explorer role; metrics must skip rather than silently substitute it.

callers: root coordinator if a future runtime exposes the role

builtInRoles.isolationValue: Potentially high, but unmeasurable until the role is actually exposed and its contract can be recorded.

toolkitRoles.purpose: Independently review an explicitly requested or substantial high-risk completed diff for actionable defects.
toolkitRoles.rationale: Its read-only boundary, high-risk trigger and independent context are distinct from post-review comment handling; the bounded evaluation matched generic security-review quality, so retain the established reviewer rather than add a narrower duplicate.

mcp: inherited configured MCP; no role-specific MCP
skills: task-triggered skills; address-pr-review is post-review rather than automatic input

callers: root coordinator after a completed diff
inputs: explicit review request or high-risk completion

overlap: address-pr-review skill after comments already exist
toolkitRoles.isolationValue: High because an untouched read-only context can challenge implementation assumptions without consuming the root context.

toolkitRoles.purpose: Map files, symbols and dependencies for one implementation question after deterministic narrowing.
toolkitRoles.rationale: The historical mapper scored below generic bounded delegation; retain no custom mapper and route repository exploration to the built-in generic subagent after deterministic narrowing. The conditional native explorer remains unavailable and must not be emulated.
toolkitRoles.isolationValue: Medium to high for large maps, but deterministic search often keeps the work small enough for the root context.

toolkitRoles.purpose: Triage existing build, test, SARIF and diagnostic artifacts without rerunning expensive collection.
toolkitRoles.rationale: Broad artifact triage overlaps deterministic summarizers and several domain skills; only a causal runtime diagnostician should be reconsidered through metrics.
toolkitRoles.isolationValue: High for noisy logs, but the broad role boundary makes routing ambiguous and duplicates cheaper structured summaries.

candidateRoles.purpose: Review security-sensitive diffs using analyzer and advisory evidence without replacing authoritative findings.
candidateRoles.rationale: All measured arms earned full semantic quality on the bounded security fixture, so one fixture provides no measured gain over the retained reviewer or generic baseline.

callers: root coordinator for security-sensitive completed diffs

candidateRoles.isolationValue: High for adversarial review of security-sensitive changes.

candidateRoles.purpose: Form and test causal hypotheses from bounded runtime measurements, traces and logs after deterministic collection planning.
candidateRoles.rationale: The candidate tied generic and the retired broad role at full quality; its single-fixture time advantage does not justify a persistent custom role.

callers: root coordinator after deterministic runtime evidence exists

candidateRoles.isolationValue: High because trace and runtime evidence is voluminous and can displace implementation context.

candidateRoles.purpose: Connect the first causal compiler or MSBuild diagnostic to source, project configuration or evaluated build state.
candidateRoles.rationale: Candidate and generic arms both reached full quality while generic used fewer tokens and less time; retain deterministic diagnose-build routing plus normal reasoning.

callers: root coordinator after a failed build

candidateRoles.isolationValue: Medium; useful mainly when build graphs or logs are too large for the root context.

candidateRoles.purpose: Select, author and assess focused tests using deterministic framework, platform, result and coverage facts.
candidateRoles.rationale: All measured arms earned full quality on bounded test assessment, so the focused testing skills and normal reasoning remain the smaller runtime surface.

capabilities.sandbox: workspace-write for authoring; read-only for assessment

callers: root coordinator for an independently bounded test task

candidateRoles.isolationValue: Medium for independent authoring and high for adversarial adequacy review; low for a single small test.

candidateRoles.purpose: Review detected upstream drift for compatibility, provenance, license and bounded adoption decisions.
candidateRoles.rationale: The built-in arm scored full quality while the candidate scored lower, so deterministic drift evidence and bounded normal reasoning remain preferred.

callers: root coordinator after structured drift detection

candidateRoles.isolationValue: High when upstream review is large enough that source context would pollute the implementation thread.

candidateRoles.purpose: Independently verify that release claims are backed by gates, identities, hashes and authorized exceptions.
candidateRoles.rationale: All measured arms earned full quality with no candidate cost advantage; deterministic release gates and bounded normal reasoning remain preferred.

callers: root coordinator before an authorized release action

candidateRoles.isolationValue: High because independence matters for release sign-off, though it must never replace deterministic integrity checks or human publication authority.
